lead.headline: 164.8 and counting: the first win is all but in, and three byes are next
lead.deck: Kamara's five touches are unexplained, Addison and Monangai were inactive, and Jefferson, Gordon and the defence are off next week.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players, and it is all on the bench. Alvin Kamara was expected to play, did, and had five touches for 2.6; Kendre Miller took the goal line, a rookie took the snaps, and nobody has reported why. Jordan Addison was inactive after the pregame workout and Kyle Monangai was inactive with no new date. Jalen Coker has not practised since his quad. None of it cost a point today, and all of it matters next week, when Minnesota and Miami are on bye and your lineup loses Justin Jefferson, Ollie Gordon and the Vikings' defence at once. The result so far: 164.8 to 85.2, with Josh Allen still to play on Monday night, and ESPN at 99%. The lineup was the projection lineup. Jaylen Warren scored 36.8 on two long touchdowns with Rico Dowdle inactive a third week. Isaiah Likely scored 32.4 on 13 targets in a game the Giants threw 54 times, trailing by 14 and then in overtime. Garrett Wilson scored 23.4 with Adonai Mitchell out again. Jefferson played and scored 18.8. Two of this morning's calls lost: the projection wanted Terry McLaurin over Gordon in the flex and Gordon won it by 2.6 because you left him in, and holding the Vikings' defence over the Jets cost 5. What is left to play is Allen. What is left to do waits for the week to roll: McLaurin into Jefferson's slot, a body into Gordon's, and on Tuesday a defence, for which you hold the first waiver claim.

Not priced: Montgomery's injury came during the game. 19 touches is volume, described and not predicted; with Montgomery healthy he had 6 and 7. What would change the verdict: Montgomery ruled out or held out of practice, which makes him a claim for a Week 6 flex that is otherwise a placeholder.

rows.name: Dameon Pierce
flags: INHERITS 195% (Saquon Barkley, Tank Bigsby, Will Shipley)
rows.reason: Lead back by default: Shipley started, scored, then left with a foot injury, and Barkley and Bigsby were out (AP; philadelphiaeagles.com). 11 carries for 14 yards and 5 targets behind a line that lost another starter. Volume with nothing produced.
rows.falsifiedIf: Barkley and Shipley are both ruled out for Week 6 against Carolina and Pierce is named the starter.

rows.name: Woody Marks
rows.reason: David Montgomery left in the second quarter with a groin injury and no other Texans back carried: 15 carries and 4 targets for Marks (AP; Yahoo box). Durable only as long as Montgomery is out, and nobody has given a severity. Houston play Jacksonville in London next.
rows.falsifiedIf: Montgomery practises in full on Wednesday.

rows.name: Samaje Perine
rows.reason: Chase Brown was not hurt: he had 13 carries, 3 catches and lost a fumble, and NBC's item says he 'takes a backseat'. Perine led with 14 carries and caught a touchdown. A performance split with no coach comment, and Cincinnati are off in Week 6. Not on the published wire.
rows.falsifiedIf: Zac Taylor names Perine the starter coming out of the bye.

rows.name: MarShawn Lloyd
rows.reason: Green Bay's lead back while Josh Jacobs is on the commissioner's exempt list: 10 carries and both touchdowns, the team's first rushing scores of the season (packers.com). Touches 7, 12, 12; the points were touchdowns at 3.1 yards a carry. Dallas at home on Sunday night next.
rows.falsifiedIf: Jacobs is reinstated, or Lloyd's carries fall under ten again.

rows.name: Roschon Johnson
rows.reason: 5 carries and 7 targets in a 31-7 loss finished by two backup quarterbacks; Swift took the goal-line touchdown. The targets fit a trailing script and no source says his role changed. He is your Monangai's team-mate.
rows.falsifiedIf: Monangai goes on injured reserve and Johnson out-carries Swift.

rows.name: Tre' Harris
rows.reason: Carried from this morning; his game was in progress at the snapshot. Johnston and Thompson inactive; McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps (Schefter). Team-high 3 targets late in the second quarter. Off in Week 7.
rows.falsifiedIf: Fewer than eight targets in the finished game, or McConkey practising in full.

rows.name: Germie Bernard
rows.reason: Rookie with a 'career-best game', 9 targets, after Pittman went on injured reserve and Roman Wilson (finger) and Ben Skowronek (calf) left in the first half (AP via Steelers Now; Steelers Depot). The role lasts as long as Wilson is out. Not on the published wire.
rows.falsifiedIf: Roman Wilson practises in full on Wednesday.

rows.name: Jerry Jeudy
rows.reason: New on the screen. KC Concepcion left with a head injury, which is where the targets came from, in an offence that completed 15 of 33 and took eight sacks (AP). Not researched beyond the game recap. Not on the published wire.
rows.falsifiedIf: Concepcion is ruled out for Week 6 and Jeudy draws eight or more targets.

rows.name: Malik Washington
rows.reason: 8 targets, steady with 8, 5, 10, 5 before it (archive). No role reporting was found today, and Miami are off in Week 6, the week this roster needs bodies.
rows.falsifiedIf: A second game of eight or more targets in Week 7.

rows.name: Dontayvion Wicks
rows.reason: De facto first receiver with DeVonta Smith out: 8 targets, alongside Goedert's 9 and rookie Makai Lemon's 7 (Bleacher Report; philadelphiaeagles.com). Hurts completed 21 of 40 and missed him for a touchdown. A three-way split in a struggling offence.
rows.falsifiedIf: Smith is ruled out again and Wicks draws ten or more.

rows.name: Chig Okonkwo
rows.reason: 6 targets with Diggs out. No reporting on his role could be opened, and Washington are off in Week 7. Not on the published wire.
rows.falsifiedIf: Eight or more targets in Week 6 at San Francisco.

rows.name: Mason Taylor
rows.reason: New on the screen. Returned today from a thumb injury and was listed as the Jets' first tight end in September (NBC Sports, 9 Sep); Sadiq left with a concussion. Three touches. Not researched beyond the recap. Not on the published wire.
rows.falsifiedIf: Sadiq is ruled out for Week 6 and Taylor draws six or more targets.

rows.name: Pat Freiermuth
rows.reason: 7 targets and touchdowns of 1 and 17 yards with Pittman on injured reserve and two receivers leaving (AP; NBC Sports). Touches 5, 5, 8: the points were two touchdowns, the fluke signature.
rows.falsifiedIf: Seven or more targets again in Week 6 with Roman Wilson out.

rows.name: Dallas Goedert
rows.reason: 9 targets in his return from injury (Bleacher Report). You start Likely, who is fifth among tight ends by ESPN's rank and scored 32.4, and this league's flex takes no tight end.

rows.name: Greg Dulcich
rows.reason: 5 targets; no reporting on his role was found, and Miami are off in Week 6. Not on the published wire.
rows.falsifiedIf: A coach names him the starter after the bye.

rows.name: Jameis Winston
rows.reason: 54 attempts came from trailing 27-13 in the fourth quarter and then overtime (AP). A game script, in a league that starts one quarterback.
rows.falsifiedIf: A second straight game of 40 or more attempts in a game the Giants lead.

rows.name: Daniel Jones
rows.reason: 44 attempts while trailing at Pittsburgh, no touchdown pass (AP). Volume from the score.
rows.falsifiedIf: Three touchdown passes against Tennessee in Week 6.

rows.name: C.J. Stroud
rows.reason: 26 of 34 with a passing and a rushing touchdown in a 26-3 win, and Houston traded for Marvin Harrison Jr. afterwards (AP). A one-quarterback league; you have a starter.
rows.falsifiedIf: Your starting quarterback is ruled out.
